'''Takekuma-teru-no-Mikoto''' (''takekuma-teru no mikoto''; dates of birth and death unknown) was a {{ill|gōzoku|ja|豪族}} of the {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}} and one of the '''{{ill|Suwa no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|洲羽国造}}'''. Also written as '''建隈照命'''.
